history.text: Recorded history opened when founders Eve Dawn and Dawn Hope established rival dynasties thirty tiles apart, surviving on wild alliums and early textiles. Tragedy soon dismantled the northern branch when five-year-old Hope Dawn starved attempting to digest an ornamental rose hip, leaving Eve entirely without junior staff and manufacturing solitary cordage on an empty stomach. To the south, the Hope dynasty has embraced middle management. Founder Dawn welcomed newborn Joy and introduced warehousing via the basket, while delegating heavy industry to nine-year-old Faith. Faith has since produced civilization's first rope, flint chips, and a yew bow in an urgent bid for fire. Humanity remains level at four living souls, though three are currently stationed in southern logistics while the solitary north reconsiders its lunch schedule.

Recorded history opened with an apparent clerical error, as founder Eve Dawn and founder Dawn Hope established two dynasties named entirely after one another roughly thirty tiles apart. Both nations initially pursued an identical domestic agenda consisting of standing near water, consuming wild alliums, and carrying their newborn daughters until well past the age of reason. Dawn Hope introduced the stone age by chipping a sharp stone, later securing dug burdock and harvested tule alongside her toddler Faith Hope. To the north, Eve Dawn gathered milkweed debris and stalks, leaving it to four-year-old Hope Dawn to achieve the miracle of thread. With no fatalities yet on file, humanity currently stands at four living souls, having successfully pioneered light industry, basic textiles, and the three-second lunch break.
